new_findings.subject: F9 uses held input and queues debug while moving; stationary is consumption gate
new_findings.counterexample: DEBUG true, moving true, interpreter idle/message false/ice-waterfall flags false, F9 held only: debug_calling becomes true; no consumption until stationary. Then F9 released, stationary, other calls false: pending debug is consumed.

new_findings.subject: Scene terminal input gate is ice/waterfall forced_movement, not move_route_forcing
new_findings.counterexample: Stationary player with route forcing true, interpreter idle, no message/menu disable/ice/waterfall flags, ACTION trigger only: menu queues and is consumed. Reverse: route forcing false but ice_sliding true blocks fresh terminal input. Direction input has separate route gate.

new_findings.subject: Cancellation result also passes through visible-to-original mapping after hidden choices
new_findings.counterexample: Same-indent first group A(cancel0), second group B/C/D(cancel1), valid branches and end items; hide original A(one-based1). Merged cancel2 returns raw1; visible mapping[1,2,3] maps raw1 to original2(C). No hiding: original1(B). Normal visible0 confirmation with hide: original1(B).
